items.title: AppLovin (APP) Stock Still Looks Cheap On Its Huge Three Year Run
items.summary: AppLovin stock has delivered very strong gains over the past three years. After a sharp pullback in recent months it still screens as undervalued on Simply Wall St’s broader checks, which raises questions about how much of that past success is already reflected in the current price. AppLovin has returned about 11x over three years. This puts a lot of focus on whether the current share price still leaves room for further long term value creation.
